changes.oldText: The Start page provides quick access to frequently used WebUI features through action cards. Each card represents a common workflow such as creating storage folders, launching sessions, deploying models, or importing projects from external URLs.
changes.oldHtml:
The Start page provides quick access to frequently used WebUI features through
action cards. Each card represents a common workflow such as creating storage
folders, launching sessions, deploying models, or importing projects from
external URLs.

changes.newText: The actions of the former Start page are now cards on the Dashboard: creating storage folders, launching sessions, deploying models, and importing projects from external URLs. The Start menu was removed; old /start links open the Dashboard, and import links such as /start?type=url&data=... still open the Start From URL dialog.

changes.oldText: If your system administrator has published an announcement, it appears as a banner at the top of every page, not only the Start page. The announcement supports Markdown formatting and may contain important notices about system maintenance, updates, or usage guidelines.

changes.oldText: You can rearrange the action cards on the Start page by dragging and dropping them. Each card has a drag handle at the top-left corner that you can grab to move the card to a different position.
changes.oldHtml:
You can rearrange the action cards on the Start page by dragging and dropping
them. Each card has a drag handle at the top-left corner that you can grab to
move the card to a different position.

changes.oldText: Your customized card arrangement is automatically saved and persists across browser sessions. The layout is stored per user, so each user can have their own preferred arrangement.
changes.oldHtml:
Your customized card arrangement is automatically saved and persists across
browser sessions. The layout is stored per user, so each user can have their
own preferred arrangement.

changes.newText: Action cards are Dashboard cards: move or resize them like any other card, and add or remove them from the Cards list of the edit sidebar. For details, refer to Adding and Removing Cards.
